text:
Good question! 🌿

Yes, the duplicate-avoidance option is part of Plant Club, so it applies to the Collector plan too.
- You can list up to **3 plants you already own**, and we'll use that list to avoid sending you duplicates.
- You still can't choose the plant itself. It stays a surprise, matched to your light level.

The knowledge base doesn't say whether your current list carries over automatically when you change plans. So after you upgrade, I'd double-check that your list of owned plants is still there, and re-add it if not. Do this before the **25th**, so it's in place for your next box.

If you can't find or update the list, you can email us at help@leafy.example (we reply within 1 business day), and we'll look into it.

Is there anything else I can help with? Happy upgrading! 🌱
